subject: Class 10 Hindi
completionRules: Map Course A and Course B independently to the CBSE 2026-27 syllabus.
Do not mark a topic complete until syllabus mapping is verified and the target question count is met.
Each MCQ must have exactly four options, a valid zero-based answer index, an explanation, and a difficulty label.
Check for repeated stems, ambiguous answers, factual errors, and distractors that are obviously unrelated.
Retain valid existing questions; do not regenerate completed content.
knownGaps: The current 27-topic bank has 254 questions (9-10 per topic), not 100 per approved topic.
The official CBSE 2026-27 curriculum lists separate Hindi Course A and Course B; the legacy bank contains older chapter selections and must not be treated as a fully reconciled 2026-27 syllabus bank.
Some literature questions are thematic rather than verified against exact textbook passages; factual chapter-specific review is still required.
Course A and Course B reading-comprehension and writing-task formats need more varied practice sets aligned to the current sample papers.
Structural validation checks format and answer indices, not the academic correctness of every answer.
